##  Objectives and scope 

This chapter presents a summary of the seismic hazard and seismic design criteria for the `r params$project` mine site. The primary objective of the study is to provide a preliminary estimate of the fundamental periods and seismic coefficients $k_{max}$ for the slopes, which are correlated with the maximum ground acceleration $pga$ and the target residual displacement $D_a$.

The objectives of the study are as follows:

- ****

- ****

- Review of the seismic hazard of the site and selection of the target return periods $T_R$ (service levels) for the different stages of the project.

- Provide an estimate of the shear stiffness modulus $G_{max}$, the maximum shear wave velocity $V_S$ and the fundamental period $T_s$ of the slope, for different scenarios of geotechnical properties of the slope material.

- Provide an estimate of the seismic coefficients $k_{max}$ for different service levels in terms of residual displacements $D_a$ (performance levels).

- Perform an uncertainty assessment and provide confidence intervals of seismic design parameters for different levels of service and performance levels.

- ****
